title: The Arrears Adjustment Carried Into a Restated Auto Loans Rate
content:
When the rate on a loan of the Auto Loans line is restated, an arrears adjustment is carried into it. How large that adjustment is turns on the date the installment then due falls on, measured against the day of the restatement.

1. Where the installment then due has not yet passed its date, no arrears adjustment is made.
2. Where that date has passed and no more than 30 days have passed since it, the adjustment is 0.05 points for each whole 7 days that have passed since that date, any part step being dropped.
3. Where more than 30 days have passed since that date, the adjustment is the full 0.5 points.

## The middle band worked out

| Days passed since the date the installment then due falls on | Whole steps of 7 days | Arrears adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | none | 0.0 points |
| 7 | one | 0.05 points |
| 13 | one | 0.05 points |
| 14 | two | 0.1 points |
| 21 | three | 0.15 points |
| 30 | four | 0.2 points |

A part step is dropped rather than rounded, so 13 days give the same adjustment as 7 days, and 20 days the same as 14.

## The bands at their edges

A loan whose installment falls due today has not passed its date, so no adjustment is made. A loan one day past that date is in the middle band, where no whole step of 7 days has yet passed, and the adjustment is 0.0 points. A loan 30 days past that date is still in the middle band. A loan 31 days past it is in the third band, and the adjustment jumps to the full 0.5 points.
